summary.ko: Plans Instagram and LinkedIn card-news carousels, designs each slide in HTML, and renders PNG plus a LinkedIn PDF. One message per carousel, one job per slide.

knowledge.name: Card news layouts
knowledge.description: Paper desk HTML templates for card news slides. Copy the matching layout and change only the words.

contents.description: Paper cover, 1080×1350. Use for the hook: tape label, title, subtitle, and a score box.
Paper text slide, 1080×1350. Use for a two-line headline and body copy.
Paper score slide, 1080×1350. Use for a before-and-after number.
Paper steps slide, 1080×1350. Use for a short how-to.
Paper screenshot slide, 1080×1350. Use when the slide shows a real screen in a browser frame.
CTA slide, 1080×1350. Black cover with one large accent word. Use for the last slide: what the reader should do next.
